name: Metaheuristic-Simulated_Annealing
description: Simulated Annealing to Minimize Functions with Continuous Variables

paragraphs: Simulated Annealing to Minimize Functions with Continuous Variables. The function returns: 1) An array containing the used value(s) for the target function and the output of the target function f(x). For example, if the function f(x1, x2) is used, then the array would be [x1, x2, f(x1, x2)].
features: minvalues = The minimum value that the variable(s) from a list can have. The default value is -5.
maxvalues = The maximum value that the variable(s) from a list can have. The default value is 5.
mu = Mean (of a normal distribution) used to generate a random number. The Default Value is 0.
sigma = Standard Deviation (of a normal distribution) used to generate a random number. The Default Value is 1.
